facts.fact: Heavy snow in the night drifts the lower road shut at the gully bend; the carter turns back and Meera and Rohan lose a day, now leaving at first light the next morning.
facts.why: needed because the outline has them still in Ranu for the grove meeting and Varun's dawn arrival in chapter 24, while chapter 21 set departure for this morning.

facts.fact: A crew meeting signal is a hand's length of undyed wool cord with three hard knots and a long tail ending in a loop, left on Nimmi's latch; it means the walnut grove behind her house at moonrise. The buyer uses it, and Kiran's crew use it too.
facts.why: needed because the outline calls for a knotted cord at Nimmi's door as the crew signal.

facts.fact: Nimmi says a masked buyer has paid the lower-lane runners for any crossing medicine for two winters, in silver without haggling, and some of it reached Ranu by the back road; she has never met him.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Nimmi tell Meera and Rohan about the buyer.

facts.fact: The Shilak post file lists the three-and-tail cord as a seized crew signal; Rohan has seen it in files but never found anyone at the other end.
facts.why: needed so Rohan recognises the signal on the page.
